summary: Lower postfix -- through a reference-aware helper and return the pre-update numeric value.

target.notes: Evaluate the reference once, GetValue once, ToNumeric, compute and SetValue once, then return the old numeric value.

caveats: Do not translate property x++ into separate read/write expressions that re-evaluate the base or key.
Getter/setter side effects and exceptions are observable.

tests.name: normal postfix decrement
tests.expected_behavior: first printed value is 2 and stored value becomes 1

tests.name: edge postfix decrement computed key evaluated once
tests.input: let i=0; const o={a:2}; console.log(o[['a'][i++]]--, i, o.a);
tests.expected_behavior: computed key side effect happens once; i is 1
